# 2 Chronicles Chapter 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Son-of seven years was-Joash in-his-reigning and-forty years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Zibiah from-Beer-sheba.

**2** And-he-did Joash the-right in-eyes-of YHWH all days-of Jehoiada the-priest.

**3** And-he-took for-him Jehoiada two wives and-he-fathered sons and-daughters.

**4** And-it-was after this it-was with heart-of Joash to-renew house-of YHWH.

**5** And-he-gathered the-priests and-the-Levites and-he-said to-them go-out to-cities-of Judah and-gather from-all Israel money to-repair house-of your-God from-year to-year and-you you-shall-hurry the-matter and-not hurried the-Levites.

**6** And-he-called the-king to-Jehoiada the-head and-he-said to-him why not you-required of-the-Levites to-bring from-Judah and-from-Jerusalem the-tax-of Moses servant-of YHWH and-the-assembly for-tent-of the-testimony.

**7** For Athaliah the-wicked her-sons had-broken-into house-of God and-also all holy-things-of house-of YHWH they-made for-the-Baals.

**8** And-he-said the-king and-they-made a-chest one and-they-put-it at-gate-of house-of YHWH outside.

**9** And-they-gave a-voice in-Judah and-in-Jerusalem to-bring to-YHWH the-tax-of Moses servant-of God upon Israel in-the-wilderness.

**10** And-they-rejoiced all the-princes and-all the-people and-they-brought and-they-cast into-the-chest until for-finishing.

**11** And-it-was at-time he-brought the-chest to oversight-of the-king by-hand-of the-Levites and-as-they-saw that much was-the-silver and-he-came scribe-of the-king and-officer-of the-chief priest and-they-emptied the-chest and-they-carried-it and-they-returned-it to its-place thus they-did day by-day and-they-gathered silver for-abundance.

**12** And-he-gave-it the-king and-Jehoiada to doers-of work-of service-of house-of YHWH and-they-were hiring masons and-carpenters to-renew house-of YHWH and-also workers-of iron and-bronze to-repair house-of YHWH.

**13** And-they-worked the-doers-of the-work and-it-went-up healing-of the-work by-their-hand and-they-stood house-of God on its-dimensions and-they-strengthened-it.

**14** And-as-they-finished they-brought before the-king and-Jehoiada the-rest-of the-silver and-he-made-it vessels for-house-of YHWH vessels-of service and-offering and-pans and-vessels-of gold and-silver and-they-were offering burnt-offerings in-house-of YHWH continually all days-of Jehoiada.

**15** And-he-grew-old Jehoiada and-he-was-full-of days and-he-died son-of a-hundred-and-thirty years in-his-death.

**16** And-they-buried-him in-city-of David with the-kings for he-did good in-Israel and-with God and-His-house.

**17** And-after death-of Jehoiada came princes-of Judah and-they-bowed-down to-the-king then listened the-king to-them.

**18** And-they-forsook house-of YHWH God-of their-fathers and-they-served the-Asherim and-the-idols and-there-was wrath upon Judah and-Jerusalem for-this their-guilt.

**19** And-He-sent among-them prophets to-bring-them-back to YHWH and-they-testified against-them and-not they-listened.

**20** And-spirit-of God clothed Zechariah son-of Jehoiada the-priest and-he-stood above the-people and-he-said to-them thus says God why are-you transgressing commandments-of YHWH and-not you-will-prosper because you-forsook YHWH and-He-will-forsake you.

**21** And-they-conspired against-him and-they-stoned-him with-stone by-command-of the-king in-court-of house-of YHWH.

**22** And-not remembered Joash the-king the-lovingkindness that did Jehoiada his-father with-him and-he-killed his-son and-as-he-died he-said may-YHWH see and-may-He-require.

**23** And-it-was at-turn-of the-year he-came-up against-him army-of Aram and-they-came to Judah and-Jerusalem and-they-destroyed all princes-of the-people from the-people and-all their-spoil they-sent to king-of Damascus.

**24** For in-smallness-of men came army-of Aram and-YHWH gave in-their-hand an-army great very for they-forsook YHWH God-of their-fathers and-against Joash they-executed judgments.

**25** And-in-their-going from-him for they-left-him in-sicknesses many they-conspired against-him his-servants for-blood-of sons-of Jehoiada the-priest and-they-killed-him on his-bed and-he-died and-they-buried-him in-city-of David and-not they-buried-him in-tombs-of the-kings.

**26** And-these are-the-ones-conspiring against-him Zabad son-of Shimeath the-Ammonite and-Jehozabad son-of Shimrith the-Moabite.

**27** And-his-sons and-abundance-of the-burden upon-him and-founding-of house-of God behold-them written on midrash-of book-of the-kings and-he-reigned Amaziah his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **24:2**: all days-of Jehoiada — The qualifier is devastating in retrospect. Joash's faithfulness depends entirely on his mentor's presence. Without Jehoiada, he collapses.

- **24:16**: with the-kings — A priest buried among kings — an extraordinary honor reflecting the Chronicler's conviction that Jehoiada's service exceeded that of most monarchs.

- **24:21-22**: they-stoned-him...in-court-of house-of YHWH — Murder in the temple courtyard. The most sacred space becomes a place of martyrdom. Zechariah's dying prayer echoes through later tradition (cf. Matthew 23:35).

- **24:24**: in-smallness-of men — A small Aramean force defeats a large Judean army because God has switched sides. Military strength is irrelevant when divine favor is withdrawn.


— EMET
